description: Start a sprint of a project's board: it becomes 'active', starting now (or on 'startDate'). A board has one active sprint at a time — starting a second is refused and the answer names the one that is going ('active'); complete it with complete_sprint first. A closed sprint is not started again. Starting the sprint that is already active changes nothing and says 'already'. Needs full write access to the project (member, admin or lead); a reporter, a commenter or a read-only member is refused with the reason, as is anybody while the project is paused or archived. Written in the project's journal under your name.

endDate.description: When it ends: YYYY-MM-DD, or a moment with its zone. Left out: the end it already has.

projectKey.description: Project key whose board holds the sprint, e.g. 'PM'.

sprint.description: The sprint, by name or id from list_sprints.

startDate.description: When it starts, if not now: YYYY-MM-DD, or a moment with its zone.

name: start_sprint
title: Start sprint
